suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify and enforce how `interactiveChecks` should be handled for non-UI or test-only fixes so `followedProcedure` cannot be marked true when required procedure evidence is missing.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Both fix reviews (`fix-strava-scrutiny`, `fix-strava-test-url`) observed handoffs with `followedProcedure: true` but no interactive checks, despite skill text requiring manual verification entries.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add guidance that when introducing new environment variables used by runtime code, workers must also update shared environment knowledge (`.factory/library/environment.md`) in the same feature.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: `VITE_API_BASE_URL` is now used by frontend API helper code but was not recorded in shared environment knowledge, which can cause setup drift across workers.
